configure_sta: configure Sliding Tile Attention mask strategy using searching, tuning, or inference mode with mask candidates and layer parameters
read_specific_json_files: read and parse JSON files containing mask search results from a specified directory
average_head_losses: average L2 loss values across multiple prompts for each mask strategy
select_best_mask_strategy: select the best mask strategy for each attention head based on minimum loss values
save_mask_search_results: save mask search results with L1 and L2 losses to a JSON file
